about: Neuryo v2 mannequin head. Mesh: MakeHuman 1.x base mesh (CC0 1.0), head, neck and shoulders, smoothed once, scaled to a 540 mm head circumference (mid-point of Indian adult male 548 mm and female 532 mm means, library P190). Units mm; y up, face +z, wearer's left +x; origin at the head centre used for az/el.
method: Sites measured on the skull surface with the 10-20 rules (IFCN, library P01): nasion-inion midline arc for Fpz, Fz, Cz, Pz, Oz; preauricular-Cz-preauricular arc for T7, T8; Fpz-T7-Oz circumference for Fp1, Fp2; Nz-preauricular-Iz ring for TP9, TP10. Inion is not visible on this smooth mannequin and is taken on the back midline at nasion height + 5 mm.
tp_note: On this mannequin the ear overhangs the standard TP9/TP10 point, so both were moved 15 mm back along the same ring to clear the ear.
